total_addressable_market.description: Global high-net-worth individuals and digital nomads seeking second residency/tax optimization
total_addressable_market.tax_refugee_segment: Growing rapidly — EU tax harmonization pressures, crypto wealth, remote work

serviceable_obtainable_market.description: European (NL/BE/DE/EN) clients actively seeking Paraguay residency with willingness to pay $3K-7K for professional service
serviceable_obtainable_market.estimated_annual_leads_PY: 5,000-10,000 per year across all PY relocation firms
serviceable_obtainable_market.nexa_estimated_share: Low single digits (<5%) — room to grow 5-10x with digital acquisition

paraguay_competitive_landscape.unserved_need: Tech-enabled, AI-powered relocation service with transparent pricing and digital-first experience

macro_tailwinds: 10% territorial tax system vs 30-50% in Europe — massive pull factor
Remote work normalization — 40M+ digital nomads globally by 2026
EU tax harmonization (DAC7, OECD BEPS) driving tax optimization demand
Paraguay political stability relative to region
Growing Dutch/Belgian expat community (200+ families served by Nexa)
Paraguay is one of the easiest/fastest residency programs in the Americas

niche_analysis.niche_size: Small but growing. 200+ families. Dutch community in PY is active and self-reinforcing.

niche_moat.language_barrier: Most PY relocation firms operate in ES/EN only — NL+DE is a real moat
niche_moat.local_knowledge: Deep relationships with migraciones, banks, notaries, registro
niche_moat.bundle: Combined residency+banking+real estate in one coordinated trip
niche_moat.team_proximity: On-the-ground in Asunción with legal/accounting team

niche_risks: Benelux segment is small (total PY relocation from NL/BE perhaps 500-1000 families/year)
Language advantage erodes as competitors add Dutch

High — growing segment, lower service intensity
Medium — younger, lower ticket but higher volume
